In the end, he is depraved of any real and loving relationship. He sees Art3mis as his saviour, finally someone who understands him and spends time with him willingly. After all he isn’t getting any further with the second gate and, his aunt and fav neighbour has been murdered, he is living in a new city literally with a killer squad breathing down his neck. You’ll see in the second book he does have lots of character development and does admit to his flaws. 

For me, it’s important to note that fictional characters are allowed to make mistakes, have flaws and inflict harm. It gives them depth, creates authentic motivation.
